# omega11 evidence manifest

Builder-made. Committed copies replace the home path with `<HOME>`, the user name with `<USER>` and the owner
e-mail with `<OWNER-EMAIL>`, so a copy's hash differs from the original whenever such a string was in it. Originals
stay in the session scratchpad (`aegis/omega11/`). Scripts, source-tree copies, build output, ledger and record logs are
not copied.
